question: Which former Miss India, also the recipient of the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, popularised Indian classical dance in the west?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indrani Rahman.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Indrani Rahman:-**

 
 
• She was born in Chennai, India in 1930 and began learning dance at a young age from her mother, Ragini Devi, a renowned dancer and choreographer.
 
• Indrani trained in a variety of classical dance forms, including Bharatanatyam, Kuchipudi, Kathakali, and Odissi.
 
• **She received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award and popularised Indian classical dance in the west. (Hence option 3 is correct).**
 
• In 1952, at the age of 22, Indrani was crowned Miss India.
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award:-**
 
 
• **It is the highest Indian recognition given to people in the field of performing arts.**
 
• It is presented annually by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy of Music, Dance & Drama.
 
• **The award is given in six categories: Music, Dance, Theatre, Other Traditional Arts and Puppetry, and for Contribution/Scholarship in Performing Arts.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Leela Naidu:-**

 
 
• She was an Indian actress who appeared in Hindi and English films.
 
• **She was the winner of the Femina Miss India pageant in 1954 and was among the top 10 finalists in the Miss Universe pageant the same year.**
 
 
 
• **Peace Kanwal:-**
 
 
• **He is an Indian actress and painter. **
 
• She is best known for her roles in Hindi films such as Dil-e-Nadan (1953), Barsaat Ki Raat (1960), and Aasmaan (1984).
